scripts.dev:author: npx --yes concurrently -k -n bff,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:author-bff" "npm run dev:author-client"
scripts.dev:author-msgf: npx --yes concurrently -k -n msgf,bff,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w msgf" "npm run dev:author-bff" "npm run dev:author-client"
scripts.docker:dev:clean: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full --profile author down --remove-orphans && node docker/free-dev-ports.mjs
scripts.docker:dev: npm run docker:preflight && npm run docker:dev:clean && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full up --build
scripts.docker:dev:author: npm run docker:preflight && npm run docker:dev:clean && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile author up --build
scripts.docker:dev:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile full --profile author down --remove-orphans
scripts.consolidate:locks:pnpm: node tools/remove-nested-package-locks.js && npx --yes pnpm@9 import && node -e "try{require('fs').unlinkSync(require('path').join(process.cwd(),'package-lock.json'));}catch(_){}" && npx --yes pnpm@9 install
scripts.db:push:verify: npm run db:push && npm run verify:supabase-schema
scripts.test:author: npm run test -w @elphie-syntax/author-ecosystem-server && npm run test:smoke -w @elphie-syntax/author-ecosystem-server
